summary: Iter143 — HR Onboarding Employee Status + existing-employee reuse + Doc Verification menu fix. Backend: 4/4 pytest passed (employee-status shape/counts, worker master, start-for-employee + duplicate 400 + unknown 404, existing-employee complete with employee_reused=True and unchanged total, new-joiner regression creates NEW employee). Frontend: Employee Status is default tab, 4 KPIs render + filter, Start Checklist opens dialog with 6 stages, Mark Done works, Complete dialog shows blue 'already exists in Employee Master' note for existing-employee flow, Confirm moves row to Completed with Open button. Pipeline tab regression OK (New Onboarding dialog opens with fields). nav-doc-verify href now correctly = /app/hr/employee-360?tab=docs (NOT onboarding).

integration_issues.issue: Toast/UI message after confirm did not surface the words 'existing' or 'reused' in visible text — the blue note in the pre-confirm dialog is present and clear, but post-toast copy may not explicitly mention 'existing employee' as spec-suggested (functional behaviour is correct: row becomes Completed).

Employee360 page requires an employee to be picked from the list before tab bar (incl. emp360-tab-docs) renders. Menu navigation & URL query (?tab=docs) are correct — but on landing (list view) the docs tab is not yet visible. Consider adding a hint 'Select an employee to view documents' or auto-selecting first employee.

action_items: (optional) Include 'existing employee reused / no new record' phrasing in the completion toast for existing-employee checklists so UI clearly reflects the reuse.

(optional) On /app/hr/employee-360?tab=docs landing, either auto-select first employee or show a hint so the emp360-tab-docs actually becomes active per spec — currently user must pick an employee first.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.py:74 — filter '$or' with master_category ∈ [None, '', 'employee'] is correct; consider indexing employees.master_category for faster large-tenant queries.
complete_onboarding reuse branch sets 'employee_reused' + 'emp_code' correctly and does NOT insert into db.employees when employee_id is present — verified via count-before/after.
start-for-employee returns 400 for duplicate and 404 for unknown employee_id — correct.

Frontend Onboarding.jsx exposes all required data-testids: onb-tab-status, onb-tab-pipeline, onb-kpi-*, onb-status-search, onb-status-master, onb-emp-start-{id}, onb-emp-open-{id}, onb-complete-open, onb-complete-confirm, onb-new — good coverage.

Only minor observations: (a) post-complete toast copy could mention 'existing employee reused'; (b) Employee360 page requires employee selection before docs tab becomes visible even when ?tab=docs is in URL.
